tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background: a soft off-white that reduces glare for tired eyes, following dyslexia and cognitive-accessibility guidance to avoid dazzling pure white.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards, figures and the featured panels that sit on the page. Pure white is kept off the page itself to reduce glare.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Quiet panels on the page: condition tiles, the hero instrument panel, the author's note, inputs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on white and surface (17:1). Also the fill of primary buttons and the featured condition tile.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on page, white and surface (7.5:1, WCAG AAA): ledes, captions, dates, section labels, the second half of a headline.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Hover state for ink fills, and a deep secondary block in illustration. Text on it is on-ink.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink and navy fills.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink (8.6:1), such as a condition's full name on the featured tile.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards and figures, and dividers between rows. Decorative only: never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button borders, chips, axis lines and the minor ticks of the ruler.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The signal colour, used as a splash: the data line in a figure, the active arc of the dial, the logo dot, arrows. Fills and strokes only (3.1:1 on white): never small text on white.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral when it must be text: section numbers (§ 01), badge text, links in counts. 6.0:1 on white, 5.4:1 on coral-tint.

tokens.name: coral-tint
tokens.usage: Background of badges, highlighted windows in charts, and the call-to-action tile. Put ink or coral-text on it.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: The science of the illnesses medicine struggles to explain.
styles.usage: The homepage headline only. Scale down to 44px on phones. Set the closing clause in ink-muted for a two-tone statement.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Why a good day can cause a bad week

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Condition names on tiles and card titles.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “I trusted the medical profession, even when it told me to distrust myself.”
styles.usage: Pull quotes, with a hanging opening quotation mark.

styles.name: row-title
styles.sample: Long COVID and what the research suggests so far

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Rigorous, readable explainers, with every claim sourced.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline, in ink-muted. Max 36em.

styles.name: article
styles.sample: Evidence-based medicine was defined in 1996 as the use of current best evidence.
styles.usage: Article body text (18px on phones), at a 64-character measure with 1.1em between paragraphs. The most-read style on the site.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Post-exertional malaise is the worsening of symptoms after effort.
styles.usage: Running text on pages. Keep lines to about 64 characters and space paragraphs by 1.1em.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Symptoms that continue for months after a COVID-19 infection.
styles.usage: Tile summaries, fact tables, button labels. Never smaller for anything meant to be read.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Illustrative, not patient data. Timing varies from person to person.
styles.usage: Figure captions and footnotes, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels (sentence case, the § number in coral-text), metadata, dates, reading times, chips, chart labels, citation numbers. The minimum size on the site.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between a tile's name and full name.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; section label to heading.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap of the condition bento; paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside tiles, figures and panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop (20px on phones).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Heading to content inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Column gap in two- and three-column sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Column gap in the hero.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm: the space between major sections.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Space above the footer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Focus rings and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Condition tiles, figures and cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The hero instrument panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges and system chips.

tokens.name: shadow-figure
tokens.usage: Lifts the featured figure off the page. The only shadow in the system; everything else separates with line.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, including gutters.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of ledes.

tokens.name: measure-read
tokens.usage: Maximum line length of article and body text: long enough to flow, short enough not to lose your place.
